description: This file defines a singleton object 'NotificationChannels' which manages the creation of a notification channel for prayer reminders within an Android app. It includes a method to ensure the notification channel exists, creating it if necessary, using Android's NotificationChannel API.

classes.name: NotificationChannels
classes.description: A singleton object responsible for managing notification channels related to prayer reminders.

methods.name: ensureCreated
methods.description: Ensures that the prayer reminders notification channel is created; creates it if it does not exist, for Android Oreo and above.
